data.name: Afsanah
data.gender_notes: Afsanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A tale, a narrative, a story
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Afsanah refers to a beautiful and captivating narrative or story. The name is derived from the Arabic root words 'afsana' which means 'to narrate, tell a story, or describe'. The name signifies the power of storytelling in inspiring, educating, and bringing people together. The name Afsanah carries the meaning “A tale, a narrative, a story” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afsanah usually hope their child will grow to embody a tale, a narrative, a story and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the power of stories in conveying wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Afsanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A tale, a narrative, a story.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afsanah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أفسانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أفسانة هي كلمة عربية تعني القصة أو الحكاية الجميلة، وهي مشتقة من الفعل فَسَنَ الذي يعني حكي أو روي، وتستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف القصص الرائعة والجميلة التي تحكي عن الأبطال والبطلات، وتعتبر الأفسانة جزءاً من التراث الإسلامي والثقافة العربية

in_urdu.name: افسانہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: افسانہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت کہانی یا داستان، یہ لفظ عربی فعل فَسَنَ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا معنی ہے کہانی سنانا یا بیان کرنا، اور اسے اردو زبان میں بھی استعمال کیا جاتا ہے تاکہ خوبصورت اور رومانوی کہانیوں کو بیان کیا جا سکے

in_hindi.name: अफ़साना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफ़साना एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर कहानी या कथा, यह शब्द अरबी क्रिया फَسَنَ से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है कहानी सुनाना या वर्णन करना, और इसका उपयोग हिंदी में भी किया जाता है ताकि सुंदर और रोमांटिक कहानियों को वर्णित किया जा सके

in_pashto.name: افسانہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: افسانہ د عربي کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنا یې ښکلی کیسې یا داستان دی، دا کلمه د عربي فعل فَسَنَ څخه اخیستل شوی ده چې معنا یې کيسې کول یا بیان کول دي، او دې ته په پښتو ژبه کې هم کارول کیږي څو ښکلي او رومانتيک کیسې بیان کړي

in_english.name: Afsanah

data.cultural_impact: The art of storytelling is deeply ingrained in Islamic culture, and Afsanah represents this rich tradition. From the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) using parables and stories as a teaching tool to the countless tales of heroes and quests that have been passed down through generations, stories have played a significant role in preserving and sharing Islamic values. Afsanah, as a name that embodies the power of storytelling, carries with it a sense of history, heritage, and community.
data.spiritual_significance: Afsanah also holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic thought. Stories, whether they are about the Prophets (AS), the Saints, or the virtues of good character, help us understand abstract concepts and connect with our faith on a deeper level. They serve as a means of inspiration, encouraging us to strive for virtues such as patience, compassion, and wisdom. Additionally, the power of storytelling is mentioned in the Quran and Hadiths, emphasizing its importance in sharing knowledge and strengthening the bond between people. Thus, the name Afsanah is not only a beautiful reminder of the power of storytelling but also a testament to its enduring spiritual and cultural significance in the Islamic tradition.
